about.heroSubtitle: Wild Haven — unique villas in the most beautiful corners of the world
about.story1: Wild Haven was born in 2020 from a simple idea — to help people find places far from the noise of the city, face to face with nature. We choose every villa by hand and personally check its views, comfort and atmosphere.
about.story2: Today we have given more than a thousand guests an unforgettable holiday — from houses in the foothills to luxurious lakeside villas.

1.name: Lakeside Villa
1.description: A luxurious villa on the shore of Lake Lugano. A private path down to the water, a spacious terrace and mountain views await you.

2.name: Mountain Retreat
2.description: A cozy house at the foot of the mountains near Lake Como. A fireplace, wooden interior and a quiet courtyard make it ideal for a family holiday.

3.name: Modern Villa
3.description: A modern seaside villa in Marbella. An infinity pool, a spacious living room and a sunny terrace.

4.name: Quiet Haven
4.description: A peaceful house among the fields of Provence. A lavender-scented garden, an open kitchen and calm mornings await you.

5.name: White Coast Villa
5.description: A villa in the style of Santorini's famous white houses. A spacious terrace, sunset views and a quiet courtyard await you.

6.name: Tropical Paradise
6.description: A villa with a private pool among the palms on the island of Bali. A tropical garden, calm mornings and a spot close to the sea.

7.name: Jeju Island House
7.description: A modern house with wooden accents on Jeju Island. Close to the sea, with a quiet courtyard and a convenient location.

8.name: Chimyon Mountain House
8.description: A wooden house in the Chimyon mountains. Fresh air, forest views, a fireplace and a spacious yard for a family holiday.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal data Wild Haven collects when you use the website, why we collect it and who processes it for us.

sections.title: What we collect
sections.body: Account data (email address, name and a password that is stored only in encrypted/hashed form), your bookings (villa, dates, number of guests, price, payment status), your favorites, and reviews you write, including photos you choose to attach. Your language and theme choices are stored in your browser.

sections.title: Why we use it
sections.body: To create and manage your account, process and confirm your bookings, take payments, send you booking emails, show reviews to other visitors and keep the service secure. We do not sell your data and do not use it for advertising.

sections.title: Who processes it
sections.body: Supabase hosts our database, sign-in and file storage (servers in Tokyo, Japan). Stripe processes card payments: your card details go directly to Stripe and are never seen or stored by us. Resend delivers booking emails. Map tiles are loaded from OpenStreetMap, which may receive your IP address when you open a map.

sections.title: What other visitors see
sections.body: Reviews show your rating, comment, photos, the date and only the first word of your name. Your email address, bookings and favorites are never shown to other users.

sections.title: Storage and security
sections.body: Access rules in the database ensure each user can read only their own bookings and favorites. Data is kept while your account exists and as long as needed for booking and payment records.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You can view your bookings and reviews in your account and delete your own reviews. You can ask us to correct or delete your account and personal data at any time using the contact below; some booking and payment records may need to be kept for legal reasons.

sections.title: Cookies and local storage
sections.body: We use your browser's local storage only for what the site needs: keeping you signed in, remembering your language and theme. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies.

sections.title: Changes
sections.body: If we change this policy, the new version will be published on this page with an updated date.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: By using Wild Haven you agree to these terms. Please read them before making a booking.

sections.title: The service
sections.body: Wild Haven lets you browse villas, check availability and request bookings. Descriptions, photos and prices are provided by the villa host and may change.

sections.title: Your account
sections.body: You need an account to book. Keep your password secret and give accurate information. You are responsible for activity under your account.

sections.title: Bookings
sections.body: A new booking is held for you while it waits for payment. An unpaid booking is automatically cancelled after 12 hours and its dates become available again. A booking is confirmed when payment is received or when the host confirms it.

sections.title: Payments
sections.body: Payments are made by bank card through Stripe, in US dollars. The total is calculated from the nightly price and the number of nights. We never see or store your card details.

sections.title: Cancellation and refunds
sections.body: If you cancel at least 48 hours before the booked date, 100% of the payment is refunded. Cancellations after that are not refunded. Refunds are returned to the original payment method through Stripe and may take several business days to appear.

sections.title: Reviews and content
sections.body: Only guests with a completed stay can write a review. Keep reviews honest and respectful and only upload photos you own. You keep ownership of your content and allow us to display it on the website. We may remove content that is offensive, false or unlawful.

sections.title: Liability
sections.body: We work to keep the website accurate and available but cannot guarantee it will always be uninterrupted or error-free. Stay arrangements are between you and the villa host.

sections.title: Changes
sections.body: We may update these terms. The current version is always on this page; continuing to use the site means you accept it.
